topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks welcome students and establish the lecture's framing, scope, and intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during tumor evolution.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchies in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how normal tissue stem cell hierarchies and the cell of origin determine susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external environmental promoters, chronic inflammation, and stromal microenvironments drive and sustain tumor progression.

topics.label: Technological approaches for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews genomic, spatial, and computational techniques used to investigate tumor architecture and evolutionary dynamics.

topics.label: Lecture synthesis and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesize the multifactorial drivers of cancer evolution and conclude the lecture.
